snippet.title: Comment on faisait, sans réveil ?
snippet.description:
Paris, 1770 : le réveil existe déjà, une montre qui sonne à l'heure qu'on a réglée en se couchant (le dictionnaire de l'Académie le décrit en 1762). Mais chez Jacques, le réveil, c'est le serrurier d'à côté. Les soldats, on les réveille au tambour : à la pointe du jour, on bat la diane. Pour tout le monde, il y a la cloche de l'angélus, matin, midi et soir. Le roi, on dit que son premier valet ouvre les rideaux : « Sire, voilà l'heure. » Et la nuit ? L'Encyclopédie l'écrit : on se réveille aussi quand l'envie presse.


#Histoire #Paris #XVIIIeSiecle #CommentOnFaisaitAvant #HistoireDeFrance

snippet.title: How an Electric Car Just Broke the 500 km/h Barrier ⚡
snippet.description:
On a closed desert highway in Abu Dhabi, BYD's electric Yangwang U9 Xtreme hit 503.17 km/h—crossing the 500 km/h barrier without an engine. Normally, single-gear electric cars hit a wall long before 500: back-EMF chokes the motor, centrifugal force threatens the rotor, 2+ megawatts of current cooks 800-volt cables, 3,000 horsepower spins the metal rim inside the rubber tyre, and road bumps at 360+ km/h can lift the nose into the air. Here is how four 30,000 RPM motors with 0.1 mm stators, a 1,200-volt 30C Blade battery floor, knurled wheel rims, a 7 km hand-swept highway, and 50 kN DiSus-X active suspension solved each limit—plus the one catch in its FIA and Guinness record.

How things really work, cut open in 3D.

Sources:
FIA Official Recognition (6 Nov 2026): https://www.fia.com/news/yangwang-u9-xtreme-surpasses-500-kmh-speed-achievement-recognised-fia
BYD Official Media Hub (6 Nov 2026): https://media.byd.com/the-fastest-gets-faster-yangwang-u9-xtreme-tops-500kmh-to-set-new-global-speed-record-in-abu-dhabi/
Guinness World Records, ID 791227 (1 Nov 2026): https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/791227-highest-speed-achieved-by-an-electric-car-in-a-single-direction-run
Auto Trader New Zealand (6 Nov 2026): https://autotrader.co.nz/news/yangwang-u9-xtreme-passes-500kmh-in-abu-dhabi
Wikimedia Commons (CC0 photos): https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yangwang_U9_005.jpg · https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Yangwang_U9_004.jpg

Credits:

snippet.title: 🎄 Christmas Magic in NYC Starts Now! #christmasinnyc #nycchristmas #rockefellercenter #xmastree
snippet.description:
One of New York City's most beloved holiday traditions is back! This year's Christmas tree is a magnificent 76-foot Norway spruce from West Edmeston, New York. Approximately 75 years old, it traveled nearly 200 miles to take its place in the heart of Manhattan on November 7!

❤️ This cherished tradition dates back to 1931, when Rockefeller Center construction workers decorated a small Christmas tree during the Great Depression as a symbol of hope. The first official Tree Lighting Ceremony followed in 1933, and the rest is NYC history!

✨ Now the magic begins! Over the next few weeks, the tree will be transformed with more than 50,000 colorful LED lights and topped with the iconic Swarovski crystal star.

🗓️ SAVE THE DATE! The official Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Lighting Ceremony takes place on Wednesday, December 2, 2026, from 7–10 PM, with the grand illumination around 10 PM! 🎄
.

snippet.title: दीपावली स्पेशल मसालेदार सूरन की सब्जी | Jimikand ki sabji | Oal ki sabji | Elephant Yam Curry
snippet.description:
प्रस्तुत है खास फाइबर, पोटैशियम और एंटीऑक्सीडेंट से भरपूर  Traditional Jimikand Curry. दीपावली पर इसकी सब्जी बनाने की परम्परा भी है. इस वीडियो में देखिये Jimikand ki Sabzi Banane ka Sahi Tarika, सूरन कैसे काटें, कैसे उबालें ताकि खुजली की समस्या न हो, ग्रेवी बनाने का आसान तरीका व सर्विंग टिप्स. इस दीपावली पर  Ol ki sabji / Oal ki sabji बनायें व अपने अनुभव शेयर करें

Ingredients
Jimmikand-सूरन  300 grams
Tomato-टमाटर-2 (200 grams)
Chilli-हरी मिर्च-1
Ginger baton-ादरक-1/2 inch
Curd-दही-1/4 cup
Oil-ीआयल-4 tbsp
Cumin seeds-धनिया-1/2 tsp
Asafoetida-हींग -1 pinch
Cloves-लोंग-2
Black pepper -काली मिर्च-4
Cinnamon stick-दालचीनी-1
Black Cardamom -बडी इलायची- -1/2
Green coriander-हरा धनिया -1 to 2 tbsp
Turmeric powder-हल्दी पाउडर-3/4 tsp
Coriander powder - धनिया पाउडर-1 tsp
Red chilli powder-लाल मिर्च पाउडर-  3/4 tsp
Dry fenugreek-कसूरी मेथी -1 tbsp
Salt-नमक  -1.25 tsp
Lemon-नींबू -1/2

snippet.title: Ya'juj dan Ma'juj Makhluk yang Terkurung Ribuan Tahun, Benarkah Temboknya Hampir Jebol?
snippet.description:
di balik kisah akhir zaman, terdapat sebuah cerita misterius tentang dua bangsa yang dikenal sebagai ya'juj dan ma'juj. dalam tradisi islam, mereka digambarkan sebagai kaum yang jumlahnya sangat besar dan akan muncul menjelang hari kiamat.

kisah mereka bermula dari perjalanan seorang penguasa bernama dzulkarnain. dalam perjalanannya, ia bertemu dengan suatu kaum yang meminta perlindungan dari serangan ya'juj dan ma'juj. sebagai solusi, dzulkarnain membangun sebuah dinding penghalang yang sangat kuat menggunakan potongan besi dan tembaga cair untuk menutup celah di antara dua gunung.

sejak saat itu, ya'juj dan ma'juj dikisahkan tidak mampu memanjat maupun melubangi dinding tersebut. namun, dalam ajaran islam, mereka kelak akan berhasil keluar ketika waktu yang telah ditentukan tiba.

lalu, di manakah sebenarnya lokasi dinding yang dibangun dzulkarnain? apakah peninggalannya masih ada hingga sekarang? bagaimana gambaran kemunculan ya'juj dan ma'juj dalam ajaran islam? dan mengapa kisah ini selalu dikaitkan dengan tanda-tanda besar menjelang hari kiamat?

dalam video ini, kita akan menelusuri kisah ya'juj dan ma'juj berdasarkan sumber-sumber islam, mulai dari perjalanan dzulkarnain, pembangunan dinding penghalang, hingga misteri kemunculan mereka pada akhir zaman.

sebuah kisah yang menggabungkan sejarah, keimanan, dan misteri yang telah menarik perhatian manusia selama berabad-abad.

snippet.title: Why did this Gameoverse Fan MARRY Kit Bodega?
snippet.description:
Today a crazy situation happened in the indie animation fandom, a gameoverse fan married kit bodega. Let me explain. 

So kit bodega is the cat protagonist of the indie series gameoverse. 

Earlier today a yumeshipper called megapmb put up a couple photos of their irl marriage with kit. Don’t harass them or send them any hate. 

Here’s her and kit in their wedding dresses

Here’s their marriage certificate and their kit plush, showing they’re now legally married to kit bodega

And here’s another commission of them in the gameoverse style. 

Glitch productions themselves saw the tweet, liking it on the official account. 

It also started a trend on twitter, with artists drawing kit in a wedding dress.

Unsurprisingly the post ended up getting alot of hate. 

A few tweets pointing out that the show only has one episode so far. 

And many more saying it’s weird to ship yourself with a character and marry them. 

Personally i think the whole thing is just silly, it’s harmless fun. The art trend was quite cute, kit bodega was a nice choice of character she’s really sweet. 

I will say though that it is quite risky to do semi or even permanent things related to shows. Like a good example was when a fan of jax got michael kovach’s signature and maid jax tattooed on their arm, and then regretted it later because of the shows ending and michael getting into drama. 

Like at any point the show could get ruined and you’re stuck with a tattoo or whatever that you regret. 

So what do you think? Would you marry kit bodega? Let me know down below.
